The t93J03 closer round is running. Next I'll queue t02A03 after it and look at t00J07's stuck row.I've started the closer round on t93J03 and queued two more problems behind it.

- **t93J03:** codex-71 is working on it now (job `invoke-1791780971720-6358-a1a53b22`), and I've set myself to be woken when it finishes, with a 90-minute deadline. I started it on a fresh branch, because the branch from 10-11 was well behind master and its one useful commit was already there. Its brief names the two stuck rows: the relation locus having four components, and the orbit relation being closed.
- **Queue:** t02A03 is next, then t00J07. I've added notes on their stuck rows to their audit files. When a round finishes, I merge it if it closed, update the lemma graph, and start the next problem.

**Correction on t00J07:** I called its problem bookkeeping earlier, but it's real maths. The row whose evidence was overwritten has already been put back. The actual blocker is the row before it: it shows as done, but its result was a stop. It defined the statement of the hemisphere trivialization and never built the homeomorphism, so everything after it is waiting on a construction that doesn't exist. That's why I moved t00J07 into the closer queue.

That also points to a defect in how the loops record results: a row can show as done when it actually stopped, which hides the gap from the strategy checkpoints. Other problems may be stuck the same way without showing up. Once these rounds are under way I'll look at fixing that in the ledger tooling, rather than one row at a time.

**t99J01** is held until the point-wedge van Kampen program finishes, as planned.
